correctness.rationale: The exact complex consists of ordered subwords of 20 affine permutations of F_5; a complete generation independently found chain cell counts (5,20,60,80,20). All 60 distinct ordered triples occur, so its 2-skeleton is the full five-letter injective-word 2-skeleton, simply connected by the known full-complex high-connectivity theorem. Exact rational boundary ranks (4,16,43,20), chain compositions zero, and independent integer Smith forms with only unit nonzero factors for boundaries 2,3,4 confirm torsion-free homology H2=Z and H3=Z^17. Each of the 20 four-cells has a distinct free 3-face, hence collapses away, and elementary attaching-map reductions over the wedge-of-S2 skeleton produce S2 wedge 17 S3. The inspected package computes a specific nonzero 2-cocycle with translation-invariant and multiplier-2 anti-invariant class, determining integral H2 sign character; cellular Lefschetz traces at all 20 affine permutations then yield rational H3=Q_chi+Q[C4]+3V. These calculations concern exactly AGL(1,5), with no general-p classification.
